meta.name: CCNL Edilizia — Industria (ANCE), impiegati e quadri

notes.text: RENEWAL: verbale di accordo of 21 February 2025 (ANCE, Legacoop Produzione e Servizi, Confcooperative Lavoro e Servizi, AGCI Produzione e Lavoro, Feneal-Uil, Filca-Cisl, Fillea-Cgil) renewing the CCNL of 3 March 2022 to 30 June 2028; three tranches of the minimi from 1 February 2025, 1 March 2026 and 1 March 2027 (ANCE table of the new minimi, the same as Allegato 10 of the verbale). Normative text: CCNL of 19 April 2010 (FILLEA text), as amended by the verbali of 2014, 2018, 2022 and 2025. The testo coordinato signed on 24 March 2026 is in the ANCE members' area and was not read.

STRUCTURE: the CCNL treats operai and impiegati differently (extra months, seniority, sickness, night overtime), so the bundle splits it: edilizia-ance holds the operai of levels 1-4, edilizia-ance-impiegati the impiegati of levels 1-7 and the quadri of level 7 (Art. 77).

PAY ELEMENTS: base_salary is the national minimo of the ANCE table; the ex indennità di contingenza and the EDR of EUR 10.33 (frozen national elements of the Protocollo of 31 July 1992) are fixed allowances read from the ANCE provincial tables. The EDR is outside the TFR base (Art. 33 and 72). hourly_divisor 173: Allegato A and Art. 44 last comma.
INPS: the rates of contribution/2026/edilizia.json, by category of the worker.

IMPIEGATI E QUADRI: fourteen monthly payments, the tredicesima (Art. 63, by 20 December) and the premio annuo of one month (Art. 64, paid on 30 June for the service from 1 July to 30 June, stored as 28 June). Five biennial scatti (Art. 49). Quadri: indennità di funzione of EUR 140 a month (Art. 76), by Employment.roles 'quadro'. Prevedi: a monthly contractual contribution by level, also on the extra months.
APPRENTICESHIP: Art. 92 (ANCE text of 4 April 2019): 72/72/78/78/85/90% by semester for 36 months towards levels 2-7; the apprendistato duale and the alta formazione are not modelled.

APPRENTICE SENIORITY: the CCNL text read for this ruleset does not state whether apprentices accrue the level seniority increments or an amount of their own, and no apprentice amount is modelled. The engine pays no increment during the apprenticeship (provisional); the run is affected when the apprentice has matured increments the level pays.

limitation.remediation: Source the CCNL clause on apprentice seniority and model it as seniority_increments.apprentice_amount (zero when apprentices accrue none), then remove this note.

notes.text: SICKNESS (Art. 66): the employer pays the whole treatment of the elements 1-10 of Art. 44 (INPS pays no indemnity to the impiegati and quadri of industry) for six months, the comporto of a worker with up to two years of service. Not modelled: from two to six years the comporto of nine months with the last three at 50%, over six years twelve months with three months at 75% and three at 50%; for several illnesses or relapses the comporto of 9, 12 or 15 months in 30, whose three extra months are paid in full for the first and at 50% after. The engine stops at day 180 (days past it are marked beyond the comporto).

limitation.remediation: Model the seniority bands of Art. 66 with equal full-pay days and the cumulated comporto in 30 months.

notes.text: Art. 46: the EVR set by the provincial agreements.

limitation.remediation: Add the provincial EVR as an input.

notes.text: Art. 65: the premio di fedeltà of one month a year after 20 years of service.

limitation.remediation: Model the premio di fedeltà on seniority.

notes.text: Art. 54: the premiums on ordinary hours (lavoro festivo 45%, notturno 34% or 10% in shifts, festivo notturno 50%).

limitation.remediation: Model the Art. 54 premiums on ordinary hours.

notes.text: Art. 47, 50 and 52: the indennità speciale, di cassa and for alta montagna, cassoni and galleria.

limitation.remediation: Model the allowances of Artt. 47, 50 and 52.

notes.text: Mensa, trasporto and trasferta, set by the provincial agreements (verbale 2025).

limitation.remediation: Add the provincial mensa, trasporto and trasferta as inputs.

notes.text: Art. 43: the 1/25 for the festività of 4 November.

Art. 76: the absorption of a superminimo into the quadri function allowance. The una tantum premio di ingresso of the verbale of 3 March 2022 and the riduzione contributiva edile concern the operai only.

PREMIO DI PRODUZIONE: the premio di produzione set by the provincial agreements (Art. 44 n. 5) is owed to every impiegato; the engine reads no provincial agreement. Not modelled: the net pay and the employer cost are short of it.

limitation.remediation: Model the provincial premio di produzione with a fact naming the province, then remove this note.

source_document.title: Prevedi Nota informativa, Parte I, scheda 'I destinatari e i contributi' (in vigore dal 31/07/2026)

location.section: Contribuzione, nota 1), tabella CCNL EDILI - INDUSTRIA, Impiegati - contributo contrattuale mensile; Operai - contributo contrattuale orario
location.quote: Il contributo contrattuale è un versamento mensile al Fondo Prevedi a carico del datore di lavoro, che varia da 10 a 20 euro per ogni mese intero di lavoro a seconda della qualifica e del livello di inquadramento del lavoratore edile (applicato anche per 13° e 14° mensilità). Contributo contrattuale in vigore dal 1 ottobre 2019: 7 20,00; 6 18,00; 5 15,00; 4 14,00; 3 13,00; 2 11,70; 1 10,00; Apprendisti 10,00; Operai - contributo contrattuale orario: a) Operai di produzione Operaio di quarto livello 0,0959; Operaio specializzato 0,0890; Operaio qualificato 0,0801; Operaio comune 0,0685; c) Apprendisti 0,0700. * Il contributo complessivo di ciascun operaio è dato dal contributo orario moltiplicato per il numero di ore lavorate nel mese e viene arrotondato all'euro.

provenance.transformation: The monthly amounts of the impiegati and quadri by level and of the apprentices. Rules of the CNCE vademecum (Comunicazione 559, Allegato 1): 'il contributo contrattuale è versato per quattordici mensilità', 'per intero se nel mese abbiano lavorato per almeno 15 giorni di calendario', 'riproporzionato in relazione al ridotto orario di lavoro' for part time. Accordo of 4 July 2025: from October 2025 owed only when the employment lasts more than three months, unless the worker pays voluntary contributions.
provenance.note: Derived: the hourly amounts and the apprentice amounts are printed only in the Prevedi Scheda (a fund document, not a signatory text). The monthly amounts are the 8 EUR a month at parameter 100 of the verbale of 1 July 2014 (CNEL F012 deposit 92945, scan, p. 20) plus the 2 EUR at parameter 100 from 1 October 2019 of the verbale of 18 July 2018 (CNEL deposit 92946, scan, p. 25), times the Art. 77 parameters (100/117/130/140/150/180/200): every monthly amount matches. The CNCE vademecum of 2015 (Comunicazione 559, sha256 712a4a9c469f7e9790d96a59373f90366e87bd2082f84ce2eee7015603257a02) predates the 2019 increase (apprentice operai 0,05 per hour then). Accordo of 4 July 2025 (sha256 1032c48b677856db1393189f84c855e0cda4bf5514e3af5b3a6792fed55fd257): owed only for employments longer than three months from October 2025.

reviews.scope: Every payable rule of the impiegati and quadri read in the ANCE minimi table of the CCNL of 21 February 2025, the CCNL of 19 April 2010 (FILLEA text), the Art. 92 apprenticeship text of 2019 and the ANCE provincial tables, for the production tier; new file split from edilizia-ance.
findings: 47 records verified, 19 derived (contingenza, EDR, contractual fund, absence quota, seniority of levels 1-2, payment day of the premio annuo).
Split by category (Art. 77): the operai of levels 1-4 in edilizia-ance, the impiegati and quadri of levels 1-7 in edilizia-ance-impiegati.

base_salary is now the national minimo of the ANCE table; the ex contingenza and the EDR 10.33 are fixed allowances (derived, ANCE provincial tables), the EDR outside the TFR base. The previous consolidated values (minimo + contingenza + EDR) matched.
Aggregator sources (idealista, leggeinchiaro, businessonline, kitech) removed.
Absence quota: by_hourly 8 hours (1/173 of Art. 44 and Allegato A), not by_26, which no clause supports.
contractual_fund_uncovered closed: every operaio level has an hourly Prevedi amount and every impiegato or quadro level a monthly one.
No renewal changing the national minimi after the verbale of 21 February 2025 through October 2026.
Fourteen monthly payments: tredicesima (Art. 63, 20 December) and premio annuo (Art. 64, 30 June, stored 28 June).
Night overtime 47% (Art. 54), not the 40% of the operai.
Quadri indennità di funzione EUR 140 (Art. 76) added.
Sickness: 100% for 180 days without INPS (Art. 66 band up to two years); the longer bands declared.
edilizia_impiegati_sickness (the art. 66 treatment beyond two years of service) is recorded on every sickness run of a worker with 24 months of seniority or more, or of unknown seniority.

reviews.scope: A year and a termination of an impiegato of the 3rd level against a hand oracle, and the 23 derived rules of the file.
findings: Engine corrected: at a termination the June pay settles the ratei of the tredicesima; the Prevedi contributo contrattuale, 'applicato anche per 13° e 14° mensilità', was not charged on them (6,50 EUR and its 10% solidarity contribution short), while an extra-month run of the same ratei charges it. The settled ratei now owe it (tests/knowledge/ccnl_engine/pension_fund/services/test_prevedi.py::test_a_termination_owes_the_ratei_it_settles).

Engine corrected: the ratei settled at a termination entered the TFR base whole, the EDR included, while the EDR stays out of the TFR base in the monthly pay and in an extra-month run (0,38 EUR of TFR too much here). The settled ratei now leave out the allowances outside the TFR base.

Hand oracle (tests/knowledge/ccnl_engine/period/sector, scenarios edilizia-impiegati-year and edilizia-impiegati-june): an impiegato of the 3rd level hired on 1 January 2026 by an employer with 30 employees, across the tranche of March 2026; after the two corrections every payment and the year (gross, contributions, tax, net, TFR, employer cost) match the engine to the cent. The CCNL now covers every total of the definition of done.

The 23 derived rules stay derived: the contingenza and EDR of each level (14) are read from the ANCE provincial tables, not tabulated in the CCNL; the Prevedi amounts are rebuilt from two verbali and the fund scheda; two scatti differ between the table (8,2) and the secondary tables (8,22); the payment day of the quattordicesima and the absence divisor are stated transformations. No signatory text states them directly.
